description: This file declares CUDA kernel launch functions related to activation functions, specifically for use within PyTorch's ATen library. It includes function declarations for launching backward and forward kernels for functions like Gated Linear Units (GLU), Log Sigmoid, and GELU.

methods.name: launch_glu_backward_kernel
methods.description: Launches the backward kernel for the GLU activation function.

methods.name: launch_log_sigmoid_forward_kernel
methods.description: Launches the forward kernel for the Log Sigmoid activation function.

methods.name: GeluCUDAKernelImpl
methods.description: Implementation of the CUDA kernel for GELU activation, with an approximation parameter.

methods.name: GeluBackwardCUDAKernelImpl
methods.description: Implementation of the CUDA kernel for the backward pass of GELU activation, with an approximation parameter.
